scope: Native mathematical adapter over supplied synthetic label factory evidence and candidate coordinates only
reference: candidate_compatibility.py and its frozen supplied-grid behavior contract
evidence_contract: Inputs must be unmodified factory-produced value snapshots. C++ records own their vectors but are mutable; forged or later-mutated evidence validation is outside this API contract.
typed_api_boundary: C++ int64 coordinates, fixed arrays, int labels and bool fields cannot identify Python bool/float conversions or wrong-length dynamic containers after conversion. A later textual fixture parser must validate source domains before typed construction.
physical_ids: uint64; retain native core/edge ID domain and original full-chain indices
coordinates: std::int64_t scalar coordinates; Point=array<int64_t,2>, Padding=array<int64_t,4>. Factory canvas coordinates and scene dimensions used by signed coordinate arithmetic must fit int64 before conversion.
coordinate_checks: Every scalar subtraction/addition is checked in signed int64 before any later cancellation or outside-bounds shortcut. No rotation or second crop-origin adjustment.
padding: left,top,right,bottom are nonnegative int64; opposing sums checked in int64 before comparing to padded width/height; each sum must be strictly smaller than its corresponding scene dimension
input_failure_type: std::invalid_argument for illegal grids, padding, threshold-domain values, nonrepresentable coordinate/dimension conversion, or intermediate coordinate overflow
scene_evidence: Thin legal labels, extract every surviving full chain, index every physical vertex and all of its (chain_id,chain_index) memberships, including unsampled vertices and shared junctions. Empty scenes remain legal and retain dimensions.
compatibility: Only centers inside padded scene grid receive support; scan clipped Chebyshev radius2, surviving scene labels0..7, unsigned circular difference<=1. Invalid255 never supports.
outside_original: Diagnostic only; padding-area support is legal
outside_padded: Never clamp or rescue an outside center; retain its complete exact weight in denominator
independent_score: Count each supported owned template sample weight once; smallest compatible physical scene ID is its A witness
ordered_score: Group owned samples by owner, restore original full-chain index order and closed flag, pass complete scene topology only for chains with edges, and call the frozen exact ordered core once per original template chain
reuse: One physical scene pixel cannot repeat within one template-chain witness; distinct template chains may reuse it. Diagnostic reused IDs are sorted and list reuse by distinct selected B chain witnesses only.
zero_owned_template_chains: Retain a complete zero MatchResult with its original template chain ID, no selected case/witness, and all zero work counters
ordering: Sample rows, outside-ID diagnostics and independent witnesses follow physical sample-ID order; scene memberships follow physical pixel ID and member chain ID; chain results follow original canonical template chain ID order
score_arithmetic: GMP mpz_class for all weights, numerators, denominator and exact threshold products; verify 0<=B<=A<=D and per-chain independent sums equal A
test_before_implementation: Header contains fixed-default zero stubs only; retain parent-controlled ordinary assertion RED before implementing behavior. Frozen literal tests must then remain byte-identical for GREEN.
resource_semantics: Runtime working set is observed per process, not aggregate RSS or an OS allocation sandbox. Compiler-job committed memory includes GCC children. Metadata/import preflight retains its separately documented scope.
